architecture.reasoning: Team Task Manager is a cohesive application where tight integration between components provides better performance and simpler deployment than microservices.

techStack.frontend: Next.js 15 with App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
techStack.backend: tRPC for type-safe APIs, Node.js runtime
techStack.auth: JWT with refresh tokens, bcrypt for passwords
techStack.deployment: Vercel for frontend, Supabase for database

dataFlow.client: Next.js App Router → tRPC Client → WebSocket for real-time
dataFlow.realtime: WebSocket Server → Redis for pub/sub → Client updates

authentication.strategy: JWT access tokens (15min) + refresh tokens (7 days)
authentication.storage: httpOnly cookies for refresh, memory for access tokens

fileUpload.strategy: Direct upload to cloud storage with signed URLs
fileUpload.validation: File type, size limits, malware scanning

database.relationships: User → Team memberships, Project → Tasks hierarchy, Task dependencies
database.performance: Proper indexing, query optimization, connection pooling

security.auth: JWT implementation with refresh token rotation
security.validation: Input sanitization, SQL injection prevention, XSS protection

performance.optimization: Code splitting, image optimization, database query optimization
performance.caching: Redis for sessions, browser caching for static assets

backend.src/server/routers/: Feature-based routers (auth, users, teams, projects, tasks)
